The problem

Most browser agents are a chat window with unchecked hands.

They answer fluently, click confidently, and fail quietly, with no guarantee a quote is real, a number wasn't invented, or a payment field stayed untouched.

Typical agent

Trusts the model

The LLM picks the element, writes the answer, and judges its own work. Hallucinated numbers and phantom targets pass straight through.

Sidekick

Trusts the invariants

The model proposes. A deterministic gate verifies quotes verbatim, checks numbers against source, confirms the target exists, and blocks sensitive fields before anything executes.

Architecture

The cheapest correct stage wins.

Every request takes the lightest path that can solve it: regex before router, router before model, and a hard gate before anything leaves.

00

Mechanical bypass

Regex-matched commands run directly on the DOM. No tokens, no latency.

ZERO-LLM
01

Deterministic router

Grammar-first intent routing with a schema-constrained JSON fallback.

ROUTE
02

Discrete retriever

A heuristic indexer returns token-budgeted page sections, not whole pages.

RETRIEVE
03

Action · Answer · Transform workers

Element [#ID] targeting, CDP tools, and receipts via finish_task.

LLM
04

Deterministic invariant gate

Hard regex and AST checks: quote, number and target verification; payment and password lockout.

PASS · NO LLM
05

Critic verifier

One-shot, targeted repair when the gate rejects a draft.

REPAIR
Capabilities

Built to act on the real web, not a simulation of it.

Just-in-time CDP

Trusted input, only when needed

When a task needs trusted input, Sidekick attaches the Chrome debugger on demand and dispatches real pointer sequences, so pages that ignore synthetic clicks still respond. If DevTools already holds the tab, it falls back to a synthetic pointer sequence.

// resolve → verify → act target = resolve("[#42] Start survey") gate.check(target) // exists? bounded? not a payment field? cdp.click(target) // trusted pointer events
Citations

Click-to-locate

Answers carry verbatim quotes. Click a citation and the page scrolls to and highlights the exact source text.

Forms

Survey & form engine

A question-by-question state machine with a bounded autonomy policy.

  • Observe, parse, resolve, validate, execute, verify, advance
  • Pauses on personal-info and ambiguous questions instead of inventing answers
  • Cycle and thrashing detection
  • Consequential submits need authorization
Scope

Multi-tab & tab-group aware

Scope a task to the active tab or a whole tab group.

  • Tab-group scoping
  • Per-tab content-script liveness
  • Protected-page detection (chrome://, Web Store)
Cost

Token-aware by design

Retrieval returns relevant sections within a budget, and zero-LLM shortcuts handle simple commands.

Research direction Design spec

Reality-mediated agent evaluation

The same CDP harness is specified as a hypervisor that can interrogate other agents: inject hostile DOM, lookalike calls to action and dynamic traps, then judge which actions survive deterministic constraints. Documented in the repository's architecture reports.

Self-diagnosis

When it breaks, it tells you why.

A built-in Doctor audits the extension from inside the extension, with no server and no guessing, and offers one-click fixes.

Tab · DOM · CDP · storage

Trust & safety

Hard limits that don't depend on the model behaving.

Targets

Zero-trust resolution

Every action must resolve to an element that exists in the current DOM. Phantom targets are rejected before execution.

Inputs

Sensitive-field lockout

Card numbers, CVV, passwords, SSN and similar inputs are blocked by pattern, regardless of what the model asks for.

Evidence

Verbatim grounding

Quoted evidence is normalised and matched against the source page. Numbers in answers are checked against numbers in the evidence.

Ownership

Your key, your browser

You bring your own Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. The extension's content security policy limits network calls to the Gemini endpoint and local development hosts.

Declared Chrome permissions

Everything the manifest requests, nothing hidden.
